rows.name: Minimal
rows.description: Trace amounts. Not enough to sustain ongoing extraction. Short-term operations have the best returns.

rows.name: Limited
rows.description: Modest but worthwhile supply. Sustained operation could focus on this Resource alone for several years.

rows.name: Sustainable
rows.description: Extensive reserves ensure the Resource remains a viable income source for some time.

rows.name: Significant
rows.description: Rich and accessible, allowing for a wide variety of approaches.

rows.name: Major
rows.description: Potential value vast, both immediate and long-term reserve. Significant investment required; supply encourages competition.

rows.name: Plentiful
rows.description: Reserves seem limitless. Would take at least a decade to deplete, barring the most aggressive efforts.
